ui.section.overrides.title: {capability} parameter overrides
ui.section.overrides.description: Override values have the highest priority. Blank means no override; booleans use true/false; numbers use JSON numbers; arrays and objects use valid JSON.
ui.section.overrides.description.mimo_au: Mimo ASR uses input_audio and asr_options. Format fields validate and construct the data URL and are also sent as input_audio.format.
ui.section.overrides.description.ark_aud: Uses Responses input_audio + input_text. Format fields are used only to construct data URLs internally.
ui.field.enabled.label: Enable MaiDock
ui.field.locale.label: MaiDock display and log language
ui.field.locale.hint: Controls the plugin configuration page, logs, and exposed errors. Reopen the configuration page after saving to refresh its text.
ui.field.config_version.label: Configuration version
ui.field.include_raw_data.label: Include raw_data
ui.field.include_raw_data.hint: Write the Provider API response summary to ProviderResponse.raw_data.
ui.field.log_summary.label: Log summaries
ui.field.log_debug.label: Log detailed payloads
ui.field.log_debug.hint: For troubleshooting only. Payloads are redacted, but this option should still be enabled cautiously.
ui.field.tool_parse_mode.label: Tool argument parsing mode
ui.field.reasoning_parse_mode.label: Reasoning parsing mode
ui.field.invalid_image_policy.label: Invalid image policy
ui.field.max_image_bytes.label: Maximum decoded image size (MB)
ui.field.max_image_pixels.label: Maximum image pixels
ui.field.max_image_dimension.label: Maximum image dimension
ui.field.max_image_frames.label: Maximum animated image frames
ui.field.user_agent.placeholder: Leave blank to use the default MaiDock UA
ui.field.reasoning_retention.label: Tool-call reasoning retention days
ui.field.reasoning_retention.hint: Complete reasoning_content is stored in plaintext in SQLite under the plugin data directory. Successful use refreshes its expiration time.
ui.field.auto_endpoint.label: Auto-detect model endpoint
ui.field.auto_endpoint.hint: DashScope multimodal and text-only models use different API endpoints. When enabled, a url error from the text endpoint switches to the multimodal endpoint and caches the choice in memory.
ui.field.ark_endpoint_mode.label: Built-in endpoint type
ui.field.ark_endpoint_mode.hint: standard = pay-as-you-go /api/v3; agent_plan = Agent Plan subscription /api/plan/v3 (requires its dedicated API key); coding_plan = Coding Plan subscription /api/coding/v3. Only effective when the native endpoint switch is on; the prefix cache is disabled automatically on subscription endpoints.
ui.field.prefix_cache.label: Enable explicit ARK prefix caching
ui.field.prefix_cache.hint: Requires Core 1.0.9 and ARK inference-cache billing. Only an initial system prefix of at least 256 tokens is cached.
ui.field.prefix_cache_ttl.label: Prefix cache lifetime (seconds)
ui.field.prefix_cache_ttl.hint: Default: 3 days; minimum: 1 hour; maximum: 7 days. Cache use does not extend its lifetime.
ui.field.max_retries.label: Maximum retries
ui.field.max_retries.hint: Maximum retries after a Provider API failure. With the switch off this is a fallback when Host provides no value; with it on this value overrides Host.
ui.field.force_max_retries.label: Override Host retry count
ui.field.force_value.hint: Off: fallback mode, where a Host value takes precedence. On: always use the configured value above.
ui.field.retry_interval.label: Retry interval (seconds)
ui.field.retry_interval.hint: Wait time between retries. With the switch off this is a fallback; with it on this value overrides Host.
ui.field.force_retry_interval.label: Override Host retry interval
ui.field.parameter.override_value.label: Override value for “{field}”
ui.field.parameter.default.blank: Blank by default. A blank value does not override and continues with the Core request-level value, model-level value, or Provider default.
ui.field.parameter.default.configured: MaiDock's default override is {value}. Clear it to stop overriding and continue with the Core request-level value, model-level value, or Provider default.
ui.field.parameter.constraints.provider: Follow the Provider's official documentation; the service may still enforce model-specific limits.
config.error.unknown_override: Unknown parameter override: Provider={provider}, capability={capability}, field={field}
ui.parameter.response_format_description: Translate Host response_format to Responses text.format
ui.hint.string: Enter string fields directly without JSON quotes.
ui.hint.boolean: Boolean override value: true or false.
ui.hint.json: Enter a valid JSON value: object, array, string, number, or boolean.
ui.endpoint.label.ark: Use the native Volcengine Ark endpoint
ui.endpoint.hint.ark: Ignore the Host base_url and use the native Volcengine Ark API endpoint.
ui.endpoint.hint.dashscope: Ignore the Host base_url and use the native DashScope API endpoint.
ui.endpoint.hint.siliconflow: Ignore the Host base_url and use the official SiliconFlow API endpoint.
ui.endpoint.hint.default: Ignore the Host base_url and use the native Provider API endpoint.
